title: PAR-134 ENC reserved-bit refusal
scope: Refuse undocumented ENC flag bits before they can shift following entity fields
Preserve the existing locally handled ACI, ByLayer, RGB, AcDbColor-reference, and transparency paths
Keep the disputed inline-RGB field width out of scope

odaSpec.version: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpec.finding: ODA lists ENC flags 0x80 for complex/RGB color, 0x40 for an AcDbColor reference, and 0x20 for transparency. It defines no payload grammar for flag bits 0x04, 0x08, or 0x10.

localCode.finding: getEnColor previously ignored bits 0x04/0x08/0x10 and returned a scalar, allowing bounded callers to continue at an unverified cursor. It now invalidates the candidate buffer before reading later fields when any of those bits is set.

productionSummary: Reject ENC reserved flag bits 0x04, 0x08, and 0x10 before consuming optional payloads or subsequent entity fields.
Leave the existing 0x01/0x02 locally handled name/index behavior and documented 0x20/0x40/0x80 paths unchanged.

generatedControls.wireAndParser: Generated ENC vectors cover ordinary ACI, the ByLayer index-256 bit, the existing inline-RGB path, the AcDbColor reference bit pair, transparency, and each reserved flag bit. Valid controls assert the following 3-bit sentinel; reserved controls assert the buffer becomes invalid before sentinel parsing.
generatedControls.evidenceBoundary: Generated vectors validate the local fail-closed boundary only and are not producer-authored DWG evidence.

openSpecQuestion.finding: The local ODA PDF text describes the inline RGB payload as BS while saying it contains the last 24 bits; a bit-short cannot encode an arbitrary 24-bit RGB value. The existing local reader consumes this field as BL.
openSpecQuestion.disposition: This slice does not alter the field width. Resolve it only with an erratum or authoritative field trace plus a producer-authored sample; do not treat the generated BL control as evidence for the specification.

evidenceLimits: No persistent drawing fixture, external producer, independent reader, native CAD application, full suite, or platform qualification was used.
No public API/layout change or support promotion was made.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
The shared worktree is broadly dirty; this slice remains uncommitted and unstaged.
nextLocalItem: Continue the exact-source PAR-03/PAR-04 associative-action context audit without changing value widths until an authoritative grammar or traceable producer witness is available.
